title: French Alps
description: Analogue photographs from the French Alps by Bart Mulder: cable cars, skiers and snow-covered chalets in a ski resort, shot on film.

images.alt: Cable car riding over snowy mountains in a winter landscape.
Ski gondolas traveling above snow-covered mountains under a clear blue sky.
Group of five skiers on snowy mountain slope with trees and snow-capped mountains in the background.
A snowy landscape with a stone and glass shelter to the right and a cable car in the distance, suspended above the snow.
Snow-covered wooden cabins in a mountain landscape with snow-capped peaks under a clear blue sky.
Snow-covered chalet-style buildings in a winter landscape with a mountain in the background and a clear blue sky.
An outdoor scene with a snow-covered building labeled 'Centre Medical,' a Ferris wheel in the background, and a clear blue sky.
A metal gondola lift with two cabins traveling in opposite directions, set against snow-covered mountains and a clear blue sky.
A gondola lift cabin labeled 'OCS' hanging from a track under a large structure, with snow-covered mountains in the background.
